analysis.reason: The test expected HTTP 200 for GET /products/1 but the API returned 404 with message 'Requested item not found'. The execution results do not include authoritative API contract documentation or test-data setup evidence to determine whether product ID 1 is required to exist. Therefore it is unclear if this is an application defect, a wrong test expectation, or missing test data/environment setup.
analysis.recommendedAction: Investigate test data and API contract: 1) Confirm whether product with ID=1 is expected to exist in the test environment (seeded test data). 2) Check API documentation for the expected behavior for requests to /products/{id} when the resource does not exist. 3) Inspect server logs for reasons the item was not found. 4) If product 1 should exist, classify as APPLICATION_DEFECT and provide failing logs/trace. If product 1 is not guaranteed to exist, update the test generator to create or reference a valid product ID (GENERATOR_EXPECTATION_INCORRECT).
